function: Learned joint control of UAV 3-D trajectory, RIS phase shifts and BS precoding with power, maximizing energy efficiency under minimum-rate chance constraints, pp. 7-8.
system: mmWave (no carrier stated) downlink: BS with 36 antennas (6x6 array), single-antenna users, passive reflecting UAV-mounted RIS, 20 x Nrow elements, no direct link, pp. 5, 10.
method: Actor-critic policy-gradient DRL (DNN with 600, 300, 250 hidden neurons, linear critic, experience replay); offline cloud training, online edge execution, periodic updates, pp. 8-10.
data_channel: Own simulated LoS channels with distance path loss, BS to UAV-RIS and RIS to users (eqs. 4-5); Poisson user arrivals; no standard model or dataset, pp. 6, 10.
test_conditions: One simulated environment; reward curves for K = 10 and K = 20 (Fig. 3); sweeps over RIS elements and minimum rate; no unseen scenario reported, pp. 10-12.
baselines: Fixed-UAV [38], Fixed-RIS [39], Static-Phase-Shift and Random (random UAV positions and RIS phases); none is stated to be a learned method, pp. 10-11.
metrics: Training reward, Jain fairness index, per-user data-rate CDF, spectral efficiency, energy efficiency (Mbits/Joule), share of users meeting minimum rate, pp. 10-12.
complexity: Orders given for training, O(Ωepi T (Zo Zl + ΣZl Zl+1)), and execution, O(|S|²×|A|); no runtime or parameter count, p. 9.
openness: none; no code or data link, p. 10.
q1_support: p. 6: "the channel gain between the BS and the RIS carried by the UAV is modeled as" a custom LoS array response with distance path loss (eqs. 4-5). Missing: any 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model, or measured data; p. 10 gives only the noise power.
q2_support: p. 9: "we trained initial models on a variety of learning tasks and environments to enhance the adaptability of the models to new learning tasks and environments with minimal re-training samples" is a design statement. Missing: a reported test on an unseen scenario or after adaptation; p. 10: "the reward evolution over time for two different user densities" shows separate curves for K = 10 and K = 20.
q3_support: p. 10: "4) Random: Here, the RIS phase shifts are set randomly." is a non-learned baseline, as is Static-Phase-Shift; p. 10: "Fixed-UAV [38]: In this approach, a UAV equipped with a RIS is hovering at a fixed location". Missing: a baseline stated to be a learned method (DQN, DDPG or an earlier DRL scheme).
q4_support: p. 9: "the computational complexity of the execution process is quantified as O(|S|2 ×|A|)"; the training order O(Ωepi T (Zo Zl + ΣZl Zl+1)) is given in Section IV-C.
q5_support: p. 10: "The simulations of the proposed algorithm are conducted on a PC equipped with an Intel Core i5-2410M CPU." Missing: a code or data link or DOI, and any public channel dataset; the environment is the authors' own simulator.
notes: Area 6 chosen over area 3: the RIS is carried by a UAV (aerial link) and the UAV trajectory is learned jointly with the RIS phases, BS precoder and power (p. 8), and the order of specificity puts 6 before 3; the reviewer should confirm. q2 and q3 are borderline: p. 9 claims fast adaptation to new environments but reports no test, and Fixed-RIS [39] is an earlier paper of the same authors that the text does not describe as learned (the reviewer may check [39]). File page 1 is an IEEE copyright page, so printed page numbers are one lower than the pages cited here. The PDF is an author version and prints no DOI.
